258:   let c = n;
259:   for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = (c & 1) ? (0xEDB88320 ^ (c >>> 1)) : (c >>> 1);

264:   let crc = 0xFFFFFFFF;

295:       const avgG = avgA > 0 ? (gSum / totalSamples) * (255 / avgA) : 0;
296:       const avgB = avgA > 0 ? (bSum / totalSamples) * (255 / avgA) : 0;
